# DCR Ltd

> 24/7 emergency commercial refrigeration repair and breakdown service across the South West of England and South Wales. Run by a qualified, F-Gas certified refrigeration engineer. Not a middleman — the engineer himself.

## Who We Are

DCR Ltd is a commercial refrigeration repair and supply company based in the Forest of Dean, covering the South West of England and South Wales. The business is run by a qualified, F-Gas certified refrigeration engineer with years of hands-on experience across restaurants, pubs, hotels, cafes, convenience stores and food retail operations.

## Primary Service: Emergency Repairs

Our main service is 24/7 emergency commercial refrigeration breakdown cover. If your commercial fridge, cold room, ice machine, blast chiller or prep counter breaks down, call us on 07928 883860. We respond same day across our service area.

## Equipment We Repair

- Display fridges and refrigerated display cabinets
- Upright refrigeration cabinets and freezers
- Undercounter refrigeration units
- Gastronorm counters and prep counters
- Cold rooms and walk-in refrigerators
- Walk-in freezers
- Ice machines and ice makers
- Blast chillers and blast freezers
- Back bar coolers and bottle coolers
- Variable temperature drawer units

All major brands repaired including: Precision Refrigeration, Hoshizaki, True, Foster, Williams, Gram, Electrolux and others.

## Secondary Service: Equipment Supply

DCR Ltd is also an authorised Precision Refrigeration reseller, supplying commercial fridges, upright cabinets, prep counters, blast chillers, undercounters, back bar coolers and ice machines at competitive prices with free UK delivery.

## Service Areas

Bristol, Bath, Gloucester, Cheltenham, Cardiff, Newport, Swindon, Forest of Dean, Taunton, Exeter, Chippenham, Weston-super-Mare and all surrounding areas across the South West of England and South Wales.

## Credentials

- F-Gas registered and certified engineer
- Authorised Precision Refrigeration reseller
- 24/7 emergency callout available
